bibliographic.title: Welcome to the Monster Mash
bibliographic.author: Grem
bibliographic.description:
Welcome to the Monster Mash!

It's Halloween, and while you're a little old for trick-or-treating, you're never too old to go on the hunt for a Special Fall Drink. To your surprise (horror? delight!?), the new café you've decided to try out is putting on a spooky speed dating event!

Made for the Bare Bones Jam #14, Welcome to the Monster Mash is an interactive fiction game made in Twine where you speed date your way through a horde of marvelous monsters! Or you would have, if I had not massively overcommitted and underdelivered 🙃🙃🙃

Alas, this is a very unfinished game, but I wanted to present what I had written so far nonetheless! I hope you enjoy what's there, and if you do, I hope you'll stick around for updates, as I fully intend to finish this game!

Either way, thanks for checking out Welcome to the Monster Mash!

.*.🎃.*.🧋.*.💀.*.☕.*.💀.*.🧋.*.🎃.*.
